purpose: Resolve reachable steady forcing, disabled recurrence, DEC/HH arithmetic, osmotic auxiliary dimensions and visualization ownership before composition

native_source.scope: Actual isolated source bodies and SciPy spline calls on supplied small graph/layout arrays; no native seeding, full solver, force-energy closure or physical geometry rebuild

source_semantics.normal_reachable: parameters unconditionally force td_deform=False; normal loop calls getDeformation after osmotic/flow and before concentration/voltage update
source_semantics.fast: No reachable deformation call in fast solver
source_semantics.shear_modulus: youngMod/(2*(1+0.49)); lame_lamb computed but unused in these routines
source_semantics.rotation_only: AA=lapGJinv*(-curl(F)); output=(G_y*AA,-G_x*AA); native bounds_closed unused; not assumed idempotent or orthogonal
source_semantics.k: dt**2*shear/1000, literal density1000 rather than configured1050
source_semantics.time_initial: Disabled t=0 path appends history then fails at removed np.float; no initialization alias/repair supplied
source_semantics.limits: Native stability/displacement checks commented out; check_v detects NaN only and timeDeform calls it only on x
source_semantics.osmotic: R*T totals include ions+molecules+GRN; mapped/averaged env minus cell; u=(deltaPi-P)*(aquaporins/mu_water)*(3e-10**2)/tm; div=u*area/volume; PP=lapGJinv*(-div*rho*dt)
source_semantics.volumes: Osmotic volume/concentration updates commented out; no mass/water ledger inferred
source_semantics.display: Sampled quartic SmoothBivariateSpline fit uses current copied centres; ev clamps targets to fitted rectangular knot bounds; displacement added to original membrane vertices; area-weighted centres/vertex histories updated; physical world rebuild commented out
source_semantics.display_repeat: Persistent display centres change interpolation abscissae on later samples; original membrane vertices remain fixed

units.pressure: Pa for P_cells and ideal osmotic pressures; native PP dimensions unresolved
units.grad_pressure: Pa/m; steady elastic inverse Laplacian divided by shear yields m
units.electric: E V/m times galvanotropism m2/V yields m after HH
units.native_PP: Linv(m2)*div(1/s)*rho(kg/m3)*dt(s) gives kg/m, not Pa; literal gradient addition is not a dimensional force-energy derivation
units.time: seconds; disabled recurrence semantics reported without physical validation
units.geometry: m, m2, m3; display only, no inferred material conservation

reference: Independent stdlib 80-digit Decimal matrix/owner loops and Gaussian-elimination polynomial least-squares display reference with rectangle clamping, plus manufactured modal mathematics

supported_domain.layout: Explicit finite source matrices/measures/owners, neutral padded rows/columns, <=256 dense cells
supported_domain.parameters: Positive shear/radius/dt, nonnegative damping, signed finite galvanotropism and pressures, explicit flags
supported_domain.dynamic: Diagnostic positive-clock branch with both history levels and positive conductivity; native time initialization remains broken/disabled
supported_domain.display: Explicit interpolation matrices; host quartic helper only captured global polynomial regime, not adaptive FITPACK equivalence
supported_domain.bounds: Optional caller-specified displacement acceptance limit, never a native clamp

scope_limits: No native tissue/geometry seeding or mechanics integration
No physical pressure-energy/elastic energy, ATP, heat, volume or water closure
No silent fixed-boundary enforcement or repair of disabled initial branch
Time/spatial refinement is scoped to supplied operators/modal mathematics; no whole-tissue settling
Caller owns clocks, histories, physical geometry, operators after cuts and checkpoint identity
